notes: Physics step rate at the live display rate: the simulated seconds per wall second must match the browser's within 5%. The demo steps one fixed step per rendered frame; the browser is paced through checks/plugins/raf-pacing.init.js and observed headed so the display's real cadence is measured.

hooks.inject: globalThis.__physicsTiming = { world, scene, samples: [] }; world._afterStep ??= []; world._afterStep.push((seconds) => globalThis.__physicsTiming.samples.push({ seconds, now: performance.now() }));

actions.waitFor: (() => { const samples = globalThis.__physicsTiming.samples; return samples.length > 30 && samples.at(-1).now - samples[0].now >= 2500; })()

actions.evaluate: (() => { const { world, scene, samples } = globalThis.__physicsTiming; return { sceneFixed: scene.fixedDeltaMs ?? 0, worldFixed: world._fixedDeltaMs, dynamicBodies: world._bodies.filter((body) => body.motionType === 2).length, samples: samples }; })()
